dedupe_keys.name: transport users benefit appraisal software and user manuals

description: The Department for Transport publishes access guidance for TUBA, software for the economic appraisal of transport schemes. The tool implements a willingness-to-pay approach for multimodal schemes with fixed or variable demand, following DfT cost-benefit guidance. Geographic coverage and appraisal periods depend on the scheme; the inspected page does not specify input file formats or model resolution. Atkins supplies the software under paid site licences, including an educational option. An active licence and user credentials are required to download it. The software licence is distinct from the GOV.UK documentation terms. TUBA provides an economic appraisal component for transport investment and capacity-planning studies. Caveats: no software or manual was downloaded, and inputs, numerical results and compatibility were not tested. Related WITA addresses additional wider economic effects; the existing National Transport Model supplies strategic transport context.
